assumptions: The unit roundoff u is nonnegative.
The accumulated gamma denominator is positive through q+n operations.
The two chained relative-error factors are bounded by gamma_q and gamma_n.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P04 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p04_t1_chained_rounding_factor (u : ℝ) (q n : ℕ) (α β : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hvalid : GammaValid u (q+n)) (hα : |α| ≤ gamma u q) (hβ : |β| ≤ gamma u n) : |α+β+α*β| ≤ gamma u (q+n)
formal_statement.plain_language: Two same-precision accumulated rounding factors collapse to one factor bounded by gamma at the sum of the operation counts.

informal_proof: Apply the triangle and product bounds to α+β+αβ, then use the gamma addition identity under the positive-denominator guard.
informal_statement: The same-precision gamma-factor core used to derive equation (3.4).
